svg.text: TrustTrail is a privacy-aware federated login for a university, built as a follow-up to Werner, Westphall &

text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Charter, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Westphall (2017), “Cloud Identity Management: A Survey on Privacy Strategies.”

'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Charter, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: tudents sign in once through Keycloak, and the library, the

text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Charter, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: learning system and the exam portal each receive only what they

text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Charter, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: have a stated purpose for. A custom Keycloak mapper enforces

text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Charter, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: that purpose binding. Every disclosure goes into a ledger whose

text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Charter, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: entries are anchored on a local Hardhat chain, so they can be audited
